page_title: Tusk: AI agent that generates unit and integration tests | Y Combinator

summary.name: Tusk
summary.one_liner: Tusk is an AI agent that generates unit and integration tests for pull requests, running as a non-blocking PR check in CI.
use_cases: Generating unit tests for new pull requests
Adding integration tests to an existing codebase
Backfilling tests for a large monolith
Catching edge case bugs before release
Increasing test coverage with minimal effort
summary.what_it_does: Tusk sits in CI and suggests happy path and edge case tests for code changes in a PR, using codebase context and business logic. It runs the tests it generates in an ephemeral sandbox, iterates on the output, and shows which tests passed or failed. Engineers can incorporate generated tests into a PR with one click and accept or decline them. Teams can customize configs for testing guidelines such as mocking approach, factories, and excluded directories. The page says Tusk is available to growth-stage and enterprise companies, with access by application.
notable: Runs generated tests in an ephemeral sandbox and iterates on results
Non-blocking PR check that suggests tests not covered by existing suite
Customizable configs for mocking, factories, and excluded directories
Page states 69% of generated test suites are incorporated into customers' PRs
caveats: Available only to growth-stage and enterprise companies; access requires applying
